# VibeSec & VibeGuard Security Intelligence

> Automated AI-Era Security Audit & Vulnerability Scanner for Web Apps, Supabase RLS, and Security Headers.

VibeSec provides developer-first, real-time security auditing for AI-generated ("vibe-coded") and modern full-stack web applications. It detects client-side database credential leaks, misconfigured Row Level Security (RLS), missing browser hardening headers, and permissive CORS policies.

## Core Capabilities

- **Database Exposure Detection**: Scans client-side JavaScript bundles and DOM trees for exposed Supabase URLs, Anon JWT keys, and public database tables.
- **HTTP Security Header Audit**: Evaluates Content-Security-Policy (CSP), Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and CORS policies against OWASP standards.
- **Automated Grading**: Provides instant A-F security scores and actionable remediation code snippets.
- **REST API & MCP Integration**: Available via public REST endpoints and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for Cursor, Claude, and autonomous agents.

## Live Services & Tools

- [Free Web Scanner](https://vibeguard-scanner.surge.sh): Instant web scanner for any live URL.
- [Live REST API Gateway](https://carey-safari-nicholas-corresponding.trycloudflare.com): High-speed JSON endpoints for automated security checks.
- [Comprehensive Security Audit & Remediation](https://newchannelid432-code.github.io/vibeaudit-landing/pay.html): Full-stack deep audit report, proof-of-concept validation, and custom RLS policy implementation ($29 / ₹2,499).
